sentence: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.

sentence: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
text: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.

quote: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.

sentence: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use". Fixed position of a movable component means the stable or natural rest position(s) of the movable component specified by the vehicle manufacturer, whether locked or not. If the above requirement is not practicable:
text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
condition: The lamp is mounted on or can be hidden by a movable component.
test_case: Place each movable component in each manufacturer-specified fixed position and measure the hidden portion of the apparent surface of the rear position lamp and retro-reflector; pass if not more than 50 per cent is hidden.

sentence: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component; or
text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21 is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
condition: The lamp is mounted on a movable component and more than 50 per cent of its apparent surface can be hidden.

sentence: A remark in the communication form (item 10.1. of Annex 1) shall inform other Administrations that more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components; and A notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.
text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21 is not practicable, a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road, except that paragraph 5.21.2. does not apply to retro-reflectors.

sentence: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer. The vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement.

sentence: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is allowed, provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate and provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function. During replacement, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
text: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp shall be allowed, provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate and provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.

sentence: Rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., are allowed, provided that: (a) The intensity of the all lamps mentioned above, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion. sentence: Environmental conditions Increase and decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed in relation to the following conditions: (a) Ambient lighting, (b) Fog, (c) Snowfall, (d) Rain, (e) Spray, (f) Dust clouds, (g) Contamination of the light emitting surface.
text: For rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, increase and decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, shall be allowed in relation to the following environmental conditions: (a) Ambient lighting, (b) Fog, (c) Snowfall, (d) Rain, (e) Spray, (f) Dust clouds, (g) Contamination of the light emitting surface.
condition: The rear position lamp is category R2 and/or the stop lamp is category S2 with variable luminous intensity control.
test_case: Verify the intensity variation is triggered only by the listed environmental conditions and stays within the regulation limits; pass if so.
quote: Environmental conditions Increase and decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed in relation to the following conditions: (a) Ambient lighting, (b) Fog, (c) Snowfall, (d) Rain, (e) Spray, (f) Dust clouds, (g) Contamination of the light emitting surface.

sentence: Traffic conditions Independent from environmental conditions mentioned under 5.26.1. a decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal or less than 20 m. However as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 50 km/h the intensity decrease already activated may remain active.
text: For rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, independent from environmental conditions mentioned under 5.26.1., a decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, shall be allowed as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal or less than 20 m, except that as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 50 km/h the intensity decrease already activated may remain active.
condition: The rear position lamp is category R2 and/or the stop lamp is category S2 with variable luminous intensity control responding to traffic conditions.
test_case: Test intensity decrease activation versus vehicle speed and following distance; pass if activation only at ≤20 km/h or ≤20 m and kept no longer than ≤50 km/h.
quote: Traffic conditions Independent from environmental conditions mentioned under 5.26.1. a decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal or less than 20 m. However as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 50 km/h the intensity decrease already activated may remain active.

sentence: No sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition. It may be possible for the driver to set the functions above to static luminous intensities.

condition: The lamp was approved with a special power supply/electronic control gear, secondary operating mode or applicant-requested voltage, and does not itself include electronic control gear or variable intensity control.

sentence: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent. text: The answer-back signal shall only operate under the park condition of a vehicle.
condition: The rear lamp is used to produce an answer-back signal.

quote: The answer-back signal shall only operate under the park condition of a vehicle.

sentence: The answer-back signal shall be provided by approved lighting and light-signalling devices and exterior courtesy lamps where in all these cases, the maximum luminous intensity per lamp does not exceed 700 cd on or above the HH line. However, front fog lamps, rear fog lamps and stop lamps are not permitted to be used.
text: The answer-back signal shall be provided by approved lighting and light-signalling devices and exterior courtesy lamps where in all these cases, the maximum luminous intensity per lamp does not exceed 700 cd on or above the HH line, except that front fog lamps, rear fog lamps and stop lamps are not permitted to be used.
condition: Whether the vehicle uses the rear lamp (e.g. rear position lamp function) for an answer-back signal
test_case: Review the vehicle answer-back configuration and photometric report: the stop lamp is not used, and any rear lamp function used has a maximum intensity not exceeding 700 cd on or above the HH line.
quote: The answer-back signal shall be provided by approved lighting and light-signalling devices and exterior courtesy lamps where in all these cases, the maximum luminous intensity per lamp does not exceed 700 cd on or above the HH line. However, front fog lamps, rear fog lamps and stop lamps are not permitted to be used.

sentence: If the answer-back signal flashes, the frequency shall not exceed 2.0 Hz.
text: If the answer-back signal flashes, the frequency shall not exceed 2.0 Hz.
condition: Whether the rear lamp is used for a flashing answer-back signal
test_case: Measure the flashing frequency of the rear lamp during answer-back activation; pass if it does not exceed 2.0 Hz.
quote: If the answer-back signal flashes, the frequency shall not exceed 2.0 Hz.

sentence: The answer-back signal may only be activated automatically in conjunction with the locking and unlocking of the door(s) and/or the detection of the vehicle user in proximity to the vehicle.
text: The answer-back signal may only be activated automatically in conjunction with the locking and unlocking of the door(s) and/or the detection of the vehicle user in proximity to the vehicle.
condition: Whether the rear lamp is used for an answer-back signal

quote: The answer-back signal may only be activated automatically in conjunction with the locking and unlocking of the door(s) and/or the detection of the vehicle user in proximity to the vehicle.

sentence: The duration of the optical indication of the answer-back signal shall not exceed 3 seconds. This time is defined from the beginning to the end of the signal, irrespective of whether it contains flashes, variations of intensity or variations in apparent surface.
text: The duration of the optical indication of the answer-back signal shall not exceed 3 seconds, this time being defined from the beginning to the end of the signal, irrespective of whether it contains flashes, variations of intensity or variations in apparent surface.
condition: Whether the rear lamp is used for an answer-back signal
test_case: Time the answer-back signal from start to end on the vehicle; pass if it does not exceed 3 seconds.
quote: The duration of the optical indication of the answer-back signal shall not exceed 3 seconds. This time is defined from the beginning to the end of the signal, irrespective of whether it contains flashes, variations of intensity or variations in apparent surface.

sentence: Any vehicle approved pursuant to this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set out in paragraphs 5. and 6. above.
text: Any vehicle approved pursuant to this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set out in paragraphs 5. and 6. above.

quote: Any vehicle approved pursuant to this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set out in paragraphs 5. and 6. above.

sentence: In their respective planes, the zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer are bounded: - In height, by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground;
text: For the visibility of a red lamp to the front and visibility of a white lamp to the rear (see paragraph 5.10.4. of this Regulation), in their respective planes, the zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground.
test_case: On the vehicle, check that no red light from the rear lamp is visible to the front, and no white light other than from the reversing lamp is visible to the rear, within zones bounded by horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m above the ground.
quote: In their respective planes, the zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer are bounded: - In height, by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground;

sentence: - In width, by two vertical planes which, forming to the front and to the rear respectively an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, pass through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width; if there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane and the rearmost to the rearward plane.
text: For the visibility of a red lamp to the front and visibility of a white lamp to the rear, in their respective planes, the zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in width by two vertical planes which, forming to the front and to the rear respectively an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, pass through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width, except that if there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane and the rearmost to the rearward plane.
test_case: On the vehicle, check visibility within zones bounded by vertical planes at 15° outwards through the overall-width contact points (foremost for front, rearmost for rear); no red light visible to the front and no non-reversing white light visible to the rear.
quote: - In width, by two vertical planes which, forming to the front and to the rear respectively an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, pass through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width; if there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane and the rearmost to the rearward plane.

sentence: In the case where the non‑textured outer lens is excluded, "7b" is the apparent surface according to paragraph 2.10.2. and F1 shall not be transparent to F2:

sentence: Position of lamps The position of lamps, as defined in paragraph 2.1.6. of this Regulation, in width, in height and in length shall be checked in accordance with the general requirements set out in paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4. of this Regulation.
text: The position of lamps, as defined in paragraph 2.1.6. of this Regulation, in width, in height and in length shall be checked in accordance with the general requirements set out in paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4. of this Regulation.
test_case: During conformity of production, measure the installed rear lamp position in width, height and length per paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4.; pass if the check is performed per these paragraphs.
quote: Position of lamps The position of lamps, as defined in paragraph 2.1.6. of this Regulation, in width, in height and in length shall be checked in accordance with the general requirements set out in paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4. of this Regulation.

sentence: The values measured for the distances shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
text: The values measured for the distances of the position of lamps shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.

sentence: The angles of geometric visibility shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation.

quote: The angles of geometric visibility shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation.

sentence: The values measured for the angles shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
text: The values measured for the angles of geometric visibility shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled, except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.

quote: The values measured for the angles shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.

sentence: The visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
text: The visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
test_case: On production vehicles, verify per paragraph 5.10. that no red light from the rear lamp is visible from the front and that white light towards the rear comes only from permitted functions (reversing lamp); pass if compliant.

sentence: Electrical connections and tell-tales The electrical connections shall be checked by switching on every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle.
text: The electrical connections shall be checked by switching on every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle.

quote: Electrical connections and tell-tales The electrical connections shall be checked by switching on every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle.

sentence: The lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
text: The lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.

quote: The lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.

sentence: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings.
text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings.

quote: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings.

sentence: These shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.

quote: These shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.

sentence: A separate approval is required for each lamp listed in paragraph 1.
text: A separate approval shall be required for each lamp listed in paragraph 1.

quote: A separate approval is required for each lamp listed in paragraph 1.

sentence: When two or more lamps are part of the same unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, approval may be granted only if each of these lamps satisfy the provisions set out in this Regulation or in another Regulation.
text: When two or more lamps are part of the same unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, approval may be granted only if each of these lamps satisfy the provisions set out in this Regulation or in another Regulation.

sentence: Lamps not satisfying the provisions of any of those Regulations shall not be part of such unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.
text: Lamps not satisfying the provisions of any of those Regulations shall not be part of such unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.

quote: Lamps not satisfying the provisions of any of those Regulations shall not be part of such unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.

sentence: If the type of lamp(s) submitted for approval in pursuance of paragraph 3.1. meets the requirements of this Regulation, approval shall be granted. All the devices of an interdependent lamp system must be submitted for type approval by the same applicant.
